name: Update Property

pathParams.name: propertyId
pathParams.description: Unique identifier of the property to update

attributes.name: Name
attributes.description: The name of the property

attributes.name: Amenities
attributes.description: Array of strings to add to the property. Providing an array of valid strings will overwrite all existing amenities. Passing in an empty array [] or an array of empty strings will clear all existing amenities. Passing in null will result in no change.

attributes.name: HomeWarrantyInfo
attributes.description: Object containing information about the property's home warranty policy. If set to null, all values within HomeWarrantyInfo will be deleted from the updated property.

attributes.name: CompanyName
attributes.description: The name of the company providing the home warranty coverage

attributes.name: ContactNumber
attributes.description: The contact phone number for the home warranty company or policy administrator

attributes.name: Expiration
attributes.description: The expiration date of the home warranty policy

attributes.name: PolicyNumber
attributes.description: Unique reference number associated with the home warranty policy

attributes.name: LeaseFeePolicy
attributes.description: Contains details about the property's lease fee policy

attributes.name: FeeType
attributes.description: The property's lease fee type. Determines how much is billed to a property per executed lease by the management company.

attributes.name: FlatAmount
attributes.description: The dollar amount billed to an owner per move in. Can only be used when LeaseFeeType is set to 'Flat'. Defaults to 0.0 if not provided.

attributes.name: Percentage
attributes.description: The percentage an owner is billed based on a full month's rent amount of an executed lease after move in, rounded to 2 decimal places. Can only be used when LeaseFeeType is set to 'Percent'. Defaults to 0.0 if not provided.

attributes.name: PropertyType
attributes.description: The type of property

attributes.name: PostedToInternet
attributes.description: Sets whether to post the Single-Family (SFR) property to third-party listings pages. Requests containing this attribute for non-SFR property types will return an error.

attributes.name: PostedToWebsite
attributes.description: Sets whether to post the Single-Family (SFR) property to the AppFolio listings page. Requests containing this attribute for non-SFR property types will return an error.

attributes.name: CustomFields
attributes.description: The custom fields for the associated entity. CustomFieldId key maps to the value to update. To clear a CustomField, set its value to null (use [] or "" for array-type custom fields).

attributes.name: CustomFieldId
attributes.description: The value of the CustomField to update. Must match the type set for the CustomField at creation. To clear the value, set to null (use [] or "" for array-type custom fields).

attributes.name: AdminFee
attributes.description: The admin fee associated with the property

attributes.name: CatsAllowed
attributes.description: The property's cat policy. Valid values include "Yes", "No" or null.

attributes.name: Class
attributes.description: Indicates the type and quality of the property based on factors such as age, location, amenities, and overall condition.

attributes.name: CurrentManagementFeePolicy
attributes.description: Contains details about the property's current management fee policy

attributes.name: FeeType
attributes.description: The property's fee type. Determines how much is billed to a property per month by the management company.

attributes.name: FlatAmount
attributes.description: The dollar amount billed once a month. Can only be used when FeeType is set to 'Flat'.

attributes.name: Percentage
attributes.description: The percentage a property is billed based on the net income generated from General Ledger accounts subject to management fees.

attributes.name: Minimum
attributes.description: The minimum management fee billed. Can only be used when FeeType is set to 'Percent'.

attributes.name: Maximum
attributes.description: The maximum management fee billed. Can only be used when FeeType is set to 'Percent'.

attributes.name: StartDate
attributes.description: The start date of the management fee policy. The date must be the first of a month.

attributes.name: WaiveWhenVacant
attributes.description: Sets whether to waive the management fee when the property is vacant

attributes.name: DogsAllowed
attributes.description: The property's dog policy.

attributes.name: InsuranceExpiration
attributes.description: The date the property's insurance expires

attributes.name: MaintenanceLimit
attributes.description: The dollar amount limit to not exceed for maintenance

attributes.name: MaintenanceNotes
attributes.description: A brief informative message about the property's maintenance

attributes.name: ManagementEndDate
attributes.description: The date when the current management of the property ended

attributes.name: ManagementEndReason
attributes.description: The reason for the end of the current management of the property

attributes.name: ManagementStartDate
attributes.description: The date when the current management of the property began

attributes.name: NsfFee
attributes.description: The non-sufficient funds (NSF) fee associated with the property

attributes.name: SiteManager
attributes.description: Contains the property site manager's contact information and details

attributes.name: Salutation
attributes.description: The site manager's salutation. Valid values include null, Mr., Ms. Mrs., Mr. & Mrs. or Dr.

attributes.name: FirstName
attributes.description: The site manager's first name

attributes.name: LastName
attributes.description: The site manager's last name

attributes.name: PhoneNumber
attributes.description: The site manager's phone number

attributes.name: UnitEntryPreAuthorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not entry to the unit was pre-authorized

attributes.name: YearBuilt
attributes.description: The year in which the property was constructed

attributes.name: Address1
attributes.description: The primary street address of the property

attributes.name: Address2
attributes.description: Additional street address information pertaining to the property

attributes.name: City
attributes.description: The city where the property is located

attributes.name: State
attributes.description: The state where the property is located

attributes.name: Zip
attributes.description: The zip code where the property is located

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the updated property
